# Safeco Safety

> Safeco Safety is a trusted South African PPE supplier offering industrial protective equipment, safety gear, and first aid supplies for construction, mining, and workplace protection.

Safeco Safety provides comprehensive personal protective equipment and safety solutions through an online store, featuring leading brands like Maxi, Greenline, Howard Leight, Kaliber, and Burnshield. The platform serves industrial, construction, and mining sectors across South Africa with bulk ordering capabilities and account management features.

## Key Topics

- PPE supplier
- Industrial safety
- Protective workwear
- Safety equipment
- Construction safety
- Mining safety
- Workplace protection
- Safety shoes
- Head protection
- First aid supplies
- Respirators and masks
- Hearing protection
- Hand protection
- Safety footwear
- Online store

## Core Platform

- [Safeco Safety Homepage](https://safecosafety.co.za): Main entry point for Safeco Safety: trusted PPE supplier offering protective gear and bulk orders in South Africa
- [My Account](https://safecosafety.co.za/my-account): User account dashboard for managing orders, quotes, downloads, and account settings

## Featured Brands

- [Maxi Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/maxi): Maxi brand: industrial PPE and safety gear for construction and professional use
- [Greenline Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/greenline): Greenline brand: FFP2/FFP3 respirators and dust masks for respiratory protection
- [Howard Leight Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/howard-leight): Howard Leight brand: hearing protection and foam earplugs for noise reduction in industrial environments
- [Kaliber Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/kaliber): Kaliber brand: durable safety shoes and boots for work environments
- [Burnshield Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/burnshield): Burnshield brand: burn treatment and first aid relief products for emergency care
- [Hanvo Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/hanvo): Hanvo brand: industrial gloves for hand protection and workplace safety
- [Medic+ Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/medic): Medic+ brand: first aid supplies, plasters, and medical emergency care products
- [First National Battery Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/first-national-battery): First National Battery brand: automotive, industrial, and cap lamp batteries for mining and construction
- [Neptun Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/neptun): Neptun brand: PVC gumboots and safety footwear for industrial use
- [Nikki Products](https://safecosafety.co.za/brands/nikki): Nikki brand: industrial safety caps and protective gear for construction
